# Vendored browser libraries

Shipped with the package so the UI works offline (lab, vehicle).

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alpine.min.js` | [alpinejs](https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine) (`dist/cdn.min.js`) | 3.14.1 | MIT |
| `uPlot.iife.min.js`, `uPlot.min.css` | [uplot](https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot) | 1.6.30 | MIT |

Update with `npm pack alpinejs@<v> uplot@<v>` and copy the files above.
